items: Equipment: list upgrades, price in subsidies
Carbon: baseline each main plant's emissions
Tracking: update after Q3 data on Oct 19

notes: Three things for the fourth quarter. One, equipment upgrades: list the projects under way and planned, check them against the equipment upgrade funds and the small-firm loan subsidy, and work out the financing savings. Two, carbon: the yearly target is now carbon intensity, so first measure the emissions baseline of our main plants on that basis, then decide whether a zero-carbon factory plan makes sense. Three, tracking: third-quarter GDP comes out on October 19, and the fourth quarter brings the bank capital bond auctions and the use of unused local debt quota, so we will update this view once they land. We ask management to name an owner for each of the three.
